title: Plumbing and mechanical systems.
officialText:
Plumbing and mechanical systems shall not be located in an elevator shaft.
Exception: Floor drains sumps and sump pumps shall be permitted at the base of the shaft provided they are indirectly
connected to the plumbing system.
